blocks.prompt: 5 A sound has intensity \(I = 10^{-6}\ \text{W/m}^2\) and reference intensity \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\ \text{W/m}^2\). Find the sound level in decibels.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh decibel ka seedha sawal hai: dono intensities di hui hain, sirf formula mein rakhna hai.
Diya kya hai? Awaaz ki intensity \(I = 10^{-6}\) aur reference (threshold) intensity \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\).
Find kya karna hai? Sound level \(L\), decibels mein.
Rule kaunsa? Decibel formula \(L = 10\log\left(\frac{I}{I_0}\right)\), jahan \(\log\) ka base 10 hai. Saath mein powers ka qanoon \(\frac{10^{a}}{10^{b}} = 10^{a-b}\).
Plan: values rakhna, ratio ko 10 ki ek power banana, phir \(\log(10^{x}) = x\) lagana.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(I = 10^{-6}\), \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\) (dono \(\text{W/m}^2\) mein).
Maloom karna: sound level \(L\) (dB).
Tareeqa: decibel formula \(L = 10\log\left(\frac{I}{I_0}\right)\). Yahan unknown \(L\) kahin phansa hua nahi, is liye sirf substitution aur simplification hai.

Values rakhein
\[L = 10\log\left(\dfrac{10^{-6}}{10^{-12}}\right)\]
Kyun: upar awaaz ki intensity \(I\), neeche threshold \(I_0\). Ulta likh diya to jawab negative aa jayega.

Ratio ko simplify karein
\[\dfrac{10^{-6}}{10^{-12}} = 10^{-6+12}\]
\[= 10^{6}\]
Kyun: same base ki powers divide hon to exponents minus hote hain: \(-6 - (-12) = -6 + 12 = 6\).
Dhyan dein: minus ka minus plus hota hai; \(-18\) likhna aam ghalti hai.

Logarithm lein
\[L = 10\log(10^{6})\]
\[= 10 \times 6 = 60\ \text{dB}\]
Kyun: base 10 ke log mein \(\log(10^{6}) = 6\), kyunke log yahi batata hai ke 10 ki kaunsi power hai.

Tasdeeq
\[10^{60/10} = 10^{6} = \dfrac{I}{I_0} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 60 dB ka matlab hai awaaz threshold se \(10^{6}\) guna intense hai, aur shuru wala ratio bhi \(10^{6}\) hi tha. Jawab sahi hai.
